title: SCS-001 — Fix code-demo pipeline auto-discover (Pipeline 2 fails every run)
rationale: Pipeline 2 (code-demo) fails on every automated run with 'No code to explain (provide --code or --prompt)' because discoverCodeDemoTopic() exists but is never called as fallback when no input is provided. Fix: wire auto-discover into generateCodeDemoScript when neither code nor prompt is given.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/code-demo-scriptgen.ts, add auto-discover fallback in generateCodeDemoScript: when neither input.code nor input.prompt is provided, call discoverCodeDemoTopic() and generate code from the result. This ensures Pipeline 2 runs successfully in automated mode.
